notes: Each condition starts from the same seed and a 300-step predator-free settling phase.
Patrol-only suppresses detection rather than scripting a movement path; the predator still follows its patrol state machine.
Pursuit-no-evasion disables only the prey evasion radius and weight, leaving pursuit behavior unchanged.
After the threat phase the predator is retreated and disabled to represent departure; recovery is measured in the last 450 steps.
Schools count connected components of at least five fish at connection radius 3.2. Captures come from real predator events.
Values are measured from the running CPU simulation; no values are inferred from another condition.
